lgn.text: Zagorka and Stonebrow lead fugitives from the defeated army in settling an abandoned city, which they name Sanctum.
After the Patriarch banishes the unmen, the glyphs overrun Sanctum and imprison Zagorka.
When Kamahl arrives with Soul Reaper, Zagorka jumps from her tower onto Phage and Akroma, and the falling Soul Reaper kills them all, and the three merge to form the goddess Karona.

scg.text: Zagorka and Stonebrow rediscover the city after the Nightmare War, and Zagorka names it Sanctum and welcomes settlers.
At the apex of the battle between Akroma and Phage, Kamahl charges in and hurls Soul Reaper, and Zagorka leaps from a tower to stop it.
The Soul Reaper cleaves Akroma, Phage and Zagorka, and their simultaneous deaths unleash ancient magic that fuses them into the goddess Karona, whom the armies stop fighting to worship.
